title: TerraTransfer++: Demonstration-Free End-to-End Planner
abstract: arXiv:2610.30319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all existing paradigms: imitation learning requires fleet-scale driving logs whose behavior distribution only thinly covers the safety-critical tail; closed-loop reinforcement learning in a photorealistic simulator, while offering diverse behaviors, is bottlenecked by sample-efficiency, per-step cost of rendering, and a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: at millions of rollout steps per second, one can obtain a state distribution with natural diversity in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains, and a highly reactive policy emerges from a basic driving-quality reward. translated_title: TerraTransfer++：免示范数据的端到端规划器
translated_abstract: 端到端自动驾驶在基准测试和实际部署中已达到最先进的性能。然而，其标准训练方案在所有现有范式下都代价高昂：模仿学习需要车队规模级别的驾驶日志，而其行为分布对安全关键的尾部场景覆盖十分有限；在照片级真实感仿真器中进行闭环强化学习虽然能提供多样的行为，却受限于样本效率、每一步的渲染成本以及大型视觉骨干网络的前向计算开销。向量化仿真器中的自我博弈改变了这一经济格局：以每秒数百万步的仿真速度，可以获得包含碰撞、险情和脱险恢复等自然多样性的状态分布——这是任何驾驶日志都不具备的——并且仅凭一个基本的驾驶质量奖励，就能涌现出高度反应灵敏的策略。我们的方法正是利用了这种不对称性：先通过自我博弈预训练一个单一策略，再将其仿真轨迹蒸馏（此处摘要原文截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出TerraTransfer++，通过利用向量化仿真器中低成本的自我博弈获得多样化的状态分布并预训练策略，再将其轨迹蒸馏到端到端规划器中，从而无需真实驾驶示范数据即可训练高性能的端到端自动驾驶规划器。
en_tdlr: TerraTransfer++ exploits the low cost of self-play in vectorized simulators to pretrain a policy with diverse collision, near-miss, and recovery behaviors, then distills its rollouts into an end-to-end planner, enabling demonstration-free end-to-end autonomous driving.
